title: DriverReportOutcome
description: What became of one report of a Driver (Canonical Model command, version 1, P12): the Driver reports Logic App tells the Driver app whether the TMS recorded it, refused it or was never reached, so the Driver sees Recorded, Refused or Not recorded instead of Sending (ADR 0016). Sent to the Driver app's outcome endpoint, which takes it only from the identity holding the role DriverReports.ReportOutcome. A report whose outcome is already known is acknowledged and left as it is, so the Logic App can send an outcome again.

driverAppEventId.description: The ID of the Driver app event the outcome is for.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID of the Driver's action, which the event carried.

outcome.description: Recorded: the TMS accepted the report. Refused: the TMS refused it, with its failure code and message. NotRecorded: the Logic App gave up after its retries, or the report couldn't be handed to the TMS at all.

failureCode.description: The TMS's stable failure code of a refusal, such as NotTripDay, or the integration layer's of a report that wasn't recorded, such as TmsUnavailable.

message.description: The readable message of the refusal or the technical cause, which the Driver reads.
